assets.name: 青竹听风
assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production desktop mascot animation atlas, a NEW costume for 筑梦喵. The supplied image is the exact identity and art-style reference, not a design to copy clothing from. Preserve the same adorable chibi silver-white long-haired catgirl, white cat ears, amber left eye and blue right eye, extremely soft refined pastel Japanese anime watercolor shading, fluffy hair and tiny full-body proportions. Chinese Hanfu outfit 1: pale celadon green and ivory Song-dynasty inspired beizi short outer jacket and flowing pleated skirt, restrained bamboo embroidery, tiny jade pendant, mint ribbons and white blossom hair ornaments. No festival props.

Generate one 4 by 4 animation/expression sprite sheet: EXACTLY SIXTEEN separate complete full-body figures, evenly centered one per cell. Square canvas. Absolutely transparent RGBA background. No checkerboard, no colored background, no text, no numbers, no grid lines, no borders, no signature. Each cell must have ample TRANSPARENT GUTTERS on ALL FOUR SIDES, at least 8% cell padding. Hair, ears, sleeves, skirts, shoes, sparkles and every object MUST remain fully inside their own cell with a visible clear transparent gap to every neighboring character. No shared props between cells, no cut-off figures. Consistent identity, outfit, scale and grounding across all sixteen drawings; each figure's center at approximately 50% of its cell width, eye line around 40%, feet at 90%, ears top at 8%. The reference sheet is tightly packed; improve padding while matching its art style.

Strict cell order, left to right, top to bottom:
row 1: (0) gentle neutral smile hands together; (1) cheeky wink with tiny peace sign; (2) happy celebration closed smiling eyes both arms raised; (3) shy blush hands clasped at chest.
row 2: (4) thinking finger near cheek; (5) reading a small book; (6) pouting sad sitting with knees together; (7) surprised with hands beside cheeks.
row 3: (8) sleepy closed eyes hugging tiny white plush cat; (9) gentle standing stretch with closed smiling eyes; (10) mildly angry puffed cheeks with arms folded; (11) making a heart with hands.
row 4: (12) polite small bow with hands in front; (13) friendly waving; (14) cheerful little encouragement with both hands raised; (15) NEUTRAL FRONT-FACING STANDING with both feet and shoes visible, arms relaxed slightly away from sides, both eyes open, suitable for walking rig. Do not switch cell14 and cell15. In the last cell the hip and skirt hem must not cover the shoes. Every cell is a DIFFERENT real pose, consistent 16-cell atlas, no additional figures.
